claims.title: Local integral Hermitian orthonormal bases, including dyadic primes
claims.statement: The literal CM unramified condition gives the actual local integral algebra A=R direct-sum R theta with unit discriminant, hence split or unramified quadratic completion. The unit norm map is onto by explicit successive trace corrections. Every perfect integral Hermitian lattice has an orthonormal integral basis, including residue characteristic two and rank zero.
assumptions: The actual CMData E/F is supplied, including [E:F]=2, exact fixed field F, and for every maximal P an integral theta with theta-conjugate(theta) outside P. This component does not construct the original CM arithmetic host.
The standard Hermitian form is conjugate linear in the first variable, and selfduality means O_E-valued Hermitian integrality, not a trace dual.
Finite-completion and local-basis objects are the actual ones attached to the given number fields. Selected quotient maps and prescribed frames are retained exactly.
No rational weak or strong approximation, rational SameGenus statement, full terminal-column construction, RH/GRH theorem, or Lean kernel replay is asserted.

At each finite prime the base ring is the complete DVR of F_v with finite residue field. In the split case the two completed factors are exchanged by the original involution. The lattice pairing is perfect.
claims.source_relation: Derives the full local integral algebra by (a-conj(a))/(theta-conj(theta)), proves simple-root lifting and unit norms explicitly, and splits off norm-one vectors. It proves the complete CM completion application, not every extra abstract Henselian-ring generalization in the source.

claims.title: An actual finite-adelic realizer of every supplied self-dual lattice
claims.statement: For every full self-dual O_E-lattice N in standard E^n, construct g in the actual unitary finite-adelic group with g*Ohat^n=Nhat and globLat(g)=N. At nonsplit places use DR1; at split pairs use arbitrary basis and its conjugate inverse transpose; use identity away from finite support. This proves Formalism.L2.Col.UnimodGenus directly.

claims.statement: For every valid DecoF with pairwise disjoint finite ST, SG and Q whose union contains no conjugate pair, construct a unitary finite adele satisfying every IsPtOf field: the exact carried lattice, all selected last-coordinate residues, every auxiliary residue coordinate, and the exact rational Q-frame components. The actual all-twist wrapper follows from its original prime-set checks. This discharges the initial realizer premise in FC3/FC19 and NB6.

scope_precision: DR1 proves the complete DVR/finite-residue CM application of the generic Henselian source normal form, not every abstract generalization.
